name: Current-account routes
blurb: Bank purchase of FX against a genuine current-account purpose. These are the routes the regulations actually make available.

name: Capital-account routes
blurb: Whole-balance exits that require SAFE approval or a documented source of property.

name: Licensed provider routes
blurb: Fintech / remittance-provider channels whose own published eligibility and price pages were retrieved.

name: Cards, cash and spending
blurb: Consume CNY value abroad rather than converting a balance in one step.

name: Hold in place / phased
blurb: Alternatives that reduce or defer conversion but do not move the balance.

name: Prohibited channels
blurb: Documented only to show the statutory exposure. No execution steps are published.
